_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco storage networking (MDS 9000), 14 Sep 2026. Series by platform: 9100 / 9200 / 9300 fabric switches, 9500 / 9700 directors, and the switching modules. Order is load-bearing: module SKUs carry fabric-switch numbers (DS-X9148 is a 48-port module for the 9500, not an MDS 9148), so the module series come first; 9700 modules (DS-X97, X9448/X9648/X9748, X9824) before the 9500/9200 ones. Accessory kits and power supplies whose SKU names a platform sit with it. No role axis.

lines.no_family_reason: Cisco names the MDS 9100 / 9200 / 9300 fabric switches and the MDS 9500 / 9700 directors as series of the MDS 9000 family, which is the line itself; director versus fabric switch is the kind (director / fc-switch), not a family
